products.product_description: SAVANNAH BEE COMPANY HONEY BBQ SAUCE MUSTARD NET 16 FL OZ (453g), PACKED IN BOTTLES. INGREDIENTS: MUSTARD (DISTILLED VINEGAR, WATER, MUSTARD SEED, SALT, SPICES (INCLUDING PAPRIKA AND TUMERIC), NATURAL FLAVOR, GARLIC), HONEY, WATER, DISTILLED VINEGAR, SUGAR, TOMATO CONCENTRATE, HABANERO PEPPERS, GARLIC, SPICES, SALT, ONION, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, NATURAL FLAVOR UPC 8 50033 93758 9 BOTTLED BY: BOBBEES FOR SAVANNAH BEE COMPANY 211 JONNY MERCER BLVD, SAVANNAH, GA 31410
products.reason_for_recall: Undeclared Allergens: Soy & Wheat. The firm was notified by a customer that the product is labeled as Savannah Bee Company Honey BBQ Sauce "Mustard", but the product inside the bottle is a different flavor of BBQ sauce. After investigation, the firm determined that the product in the bottle is their Honey BBQ Sauce "Sweet". The BBQ sauce "Sweet" contains wheat and soy which is not listed on the BBQ Sauce "Mustard" label.
